patterns.what_worked: BS-4a (the Call of the Elements line) and BS-4b (the per-family Stormstrike fallback) are built with cited slot/id/numbers: the water clock (api.GetTotemInfo slot 3), the gather feed (inputs.water_remaining / inputs.water_duration), the engine rule 9c (WRATH, water totem under 20 s, between the Searing maintain and Magma - the APL's own order), the guide slot 18, the HUD mirror, and the Stormstrike fallback (Era 20 / SoD 6 / TBC 10 / Wrath 8) on both the guide slot and the HUD mirror.
patterns.what_was_hard: The Lua 5.1 200-local wall in classes/shaman.lua, and the guide-contract pin updates that the 18th slot forces in three suites (guide_contract 17->18 + HUD 10->11, hud_state 10->11, and the excluded shaman_guide_state).
patterns.skill_gap: A static guide-slot fallback cannot know the family at load time, and the SoD build is only known when the MW rune is observed - the descriptor has to be refreshed from the gather before the frame renders it. That coupling is documented in the code but is the kind of thing a future lane could break silently.
